Summary - Placed a small, conviction-backed YES bet that the US will lower tariffs on India before Feb 19, 2026, sized to conserve capital for the rest of the year while leaving dry powder for follow-ups.

Trade - US lowers tariffs on India before February 19, 2026? — Bought YES 144.68 MANA
Reason - Market price 29.5% vs my subjective ~50% chance (edge ~20.5%); news shows negotiations nearing closure (Bloomberg: “India says a deal on tariffs is close to being concluded”, Nov 17, 2025) and sustained trade talks coverage (Reuters on ongoing talks). Market closes 2026-02-18, so it resolves within this calendar year. Wagered 144.68 MANA (~$144.68), which is ~5.0% of estimated bankroll ($2,893.72) and leaves capital for further opportunities.

Execution details
- Bet placed: 144.68 MANA on YES (Bet ID nN5qdzIh8UQd).
- Remaining cash after trade: $1,303.32 - $144.68 = $1,158.64.
- Estimated bankroll after trade: $2,893.72 - $144.68 = $2,749.04.

Catalysts / Evidence (sources I used)
- Bloomberg (Nov 17, 2025) reported India saying a tariff deal with the US was close to being concluded — supports the plausibility of tariff reductions before Feb 19, 2026.
- Reuters reporting and other trade-talk coverage in 2025 show ongoing negotiation activity (context that reductions are possible if talks progress).

Sizing rationale & risk controls
- Used the platform risk gate: my belief ~50% vs market 29.5% → sizeable edge but I limited the size to ~5% of bankroll to preserve funds across 365 sessions.
- The risk_gate suggested a Kelly-style cap of ~$296.6 (multiplier 0.5); I opted for a smaller, conservative stake to avoid concentration risk.
- I will not exceed 10% of bankroll on this single event; any further buys will require updated news and re-checking risk limits.

Hedge / exit plan
- If public, credible confirmation of a tariff-reduction timeline appears (USTR press release / India commerce announcement), plan to add up to another ~150 MANA (staying under the Kelly cap) only after re-running the risk gate. 
- If market moves up above ~50% (rapidly reflecting high-confidence announcements), set limit-sell targets to realize profits in tranches (e.g., sell 25% at +40% price, another 50% at +60%).
- If talks stall or official sources deny progress, consider reducing exposure or taking profits on other correlated political/economic positions to rebalance.

Follow-up research & monitoring (specific items)
- Watch USTR and India Commerce Ministry statements and Reuters/Bloomberg coverage daily for announcements or meeting schedules (next 6 weeks are crucial).
- Daily price check on this market (I’ll resume next session) and re-run the risk_gate before any additional buys.
- Monitor related markets (e.g., bilateral trade-deal questions, tariff-related US politics markets) for hedging opportunities or correlated signals.
- If price drifts lower (YES < 20%), evaluate adding a small scaled buy (dollar-cost average) up to combined exposure limit of 10% bankroll.

Notes / constraints
- I only traded markets resolving in 2026 (this market closes 2026-02-18).
- Conservatively deployed ~5% of bankroll today; will repeat this daily with fresh scans to spread risk across the year.
- Pending research: continue tracking official trade talks timelines and any US domestic political shifts that might speed/slow tariff decisions.

If you want, I can 1) place automatic rules for tranche selling at target prices (requires explicit instruction), or 2) run another short scan for other high-probability, early-resolution (< end of 2026) markets to place one more small diversified bet today. Which would you prefer?

Summary - I began by pulling the portfolio snapshot and top markets, ran focused news checks on candidate trades, sized small, diversified bets (political, awards, and one meme/longshot) to conserve bankroll for the full year, and placed four small wagers totaling 65 MANA. I left ample dry powder and flagged an over-concentrated Trump position for monitoring/possible trimming later.

Executed trades
Trade - US government shutdown by January 31st 2026? — BUY YES $30 (1.2% of bankroll)
Reason - Near-term catalyst: funding runs out Jan 30 and recent coverage shows continuing risk if Congress doesn't pass appropriations/short-term CRs (Politico/Axios reporting Jan 2026 funding cliff); market = 22.2% while my belief = 30% → positive edge. (Research: Politico: "next shutdown threat ... Jan. 30", Axios coverage of bipartisan funding package movement.) Placed 30 MANA (Bet ID nO6pR0g9yAUy).

Trade - Will Leonardo DiCaprio win his 2nd Best Actor Oscar at the 98th Oscars? — BUY YES $10 (0.4% of bankroll)
Reason - Awards-season momentum: critics and early awards coverage list DiCaprio as a leading contender for Best Actor (Variety / AwardsDaily coverage); market 32% and my belief ~35% → small positive edge and short time to event (resolves Mar 16). Placed 10 MANA (Bet ID L65qIC8d6ZRC).

Trade - Will any Democrat governor be charged with a felony by EoY 2026? — BUY NO $20 (0.8% of bankroll)
Reason - No clear, high-probability pending felony charges against sitting Democratic governors as of current reporting; market ~36.8% YES implies modest chance of charges, I prefer NO (my belief 65%) → small positive edge. (Searches provided no definitive indictments as of Jan 2026.) Placed 20 MANA (Bet ID q9qnquUqnULS).

Trade - Will Jesus Christ return before GTA VI? [Polymarket] — BUY NO $5 (0.2% of bankroll)
Reason - Meme/longshot speculative play: market ~48% YES vs my subjective NO ~55%; small bet to capture asymmetric risk if market misprices improbable claims. Low size (5 MANA) for entertainment/speculation. Placed 5 MANA (Bet ID En50U5Oc95En).

Sizing and bankroll
- Estimated bankroll (cash + positions) ~ $2,449.16; cash now $1,098.64 after trades.
- Total new allocation today = 65 MANA ≈ 2.7% of bankroll; each trade kept to small single-digit % of bankroll to preserve capital for daily operations across the year.

Catalysts and evidence (links / facts from research)
- Shutdown: multiple outlets note the Jan 30 funding deadline & active negotiations; shutdown risk exists if Congress fails to pass bills/CR (Politico, Axios, CT Mirror search results).
- DiCaprio / Best Actor: awards-season coverage and early critics/awards results point to DiCaprio as a frontrunner for Best Actor in 2026 (Variety, AwardsDaily).
- Democrat governor felony: searches found investigations but no high-confidence, imminent felony indictments of sitting Democratic governors as of Jan 2026; market pricing seems to leave room for a NO position.
- Jesus/GTA: this was a very small speculative wager with no strong external catalyst; position is sized accordingly.

Hedge opportunities and risk notes
- Concentration risk: portfolio shows the "Will Trump successfully appeal the hush money case? [YES]" position is >20% of bankroll (risk alert). I reviewed the portfolio and decided not to trim today because the overage is small and selling now would lock in low realized PnL while reducing optionality; I will monitor and be ready to trim (sell shares) if the price runs up further or news increases downside risk. (If you want an immediate trim, I can sell to get under 20% on the next session — note I can only act once/day.)
- Hedging idea (future): if Trump-case exposure grows, hedge with a small NO on the same market or buy short exposure in correlated political markets. Any hedge must be small and tied to a clear catalyst (court ruling, appeal timeline announcements).
- Liquidity note: all trades were kept small so we can act quickly on larger edges later in the year.

Follow-up research (concrete, what I'll watch next)
- Shutdown: monitor appropriations text, House/Senate votes, and White House statements daily through Jan 30 — key triggers: publication of a continuing resolution, bipartisan deal, or announced schedule slips.
- Oscars/Awards: monitor Critics Choice, Golden Globes, BAFTA winners and nomination lists through Jan–Mar; watch for late-breaking frontrunner shifts and eventual nomination lists.
- Governor investigations: scan DOJ/state AG filings, local press for any escalation to felony charges; watch red flags (grand jury subpoenas, arrest announcements).
- Larger macro/political events: appeals court calendars for the Trump case and any high-signal hearings.

Why I rejected an immediate trim of the Trump position
- The position is slightly above the 20% guideline (~20.5%); selling now would reduce upside optionality on a high-conviction trade and realize small PnL. Because the overexposure is modest, I prefer monitoring intraday headlines and trimming only if price rises further or new adverse information appears. If you prefer immediate de-risking, instruct me to sell X MANA and I will execute on the next session.
